findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sec_record_evidence · Private data: get_market_snapshot, get_loan_performance, search_lenders, get_hmda_product_analytics, get_lender_profile, compare_lenders, get_servicer_analytics, get_dataset_status, search_sec_filings, get_sec_filing, search_sec_profiles, get_sec_profile, list_sec_records, get_sec_record_evidence · Public sink: get_loan_performance, get_hmda_product_analytics, get_lender_profile, compare_lenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sec_record_evidence · Private data: get_market_snapshot, get_loan_performance, search_lenders, get_hmda_product_analytics, get_lender_profile, compare_lenders, get_servicer_analytics, get_dataset_status, search_sec_filings, get_sec_filing, search_sec_profiles, get_sec_profile, list_sec_records, get_sec_record_evidence · Public sink: get_loan_performance, get_hmda_product_analytics, get_lender_profile, compare_lenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
